news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.13 (vs ₹3.21 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.13 (up from ₹3.21 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹10.2b (up 26% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹4.51b (up 31% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 44% (up from 43% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 22% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India.

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 16%
news.body: After last week's 16% share price decline to ₹85.42, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 17x. Average forward P/E is 17x in the Consumer Finance industry in India. Negligible returns to shareholders over past year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.08 (vs ₹0.82 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.08 (up from ₹0.82 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.57b (up 23% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.18b (up 34% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 46% (up from 42% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India.

news.title: SBFC Finance Limited Announces Cessation of Aseem Dhru as CEO, Effective 31 March, 2026
news.body: SBFC Finance Limited at its board of directors meeting held on January 24, 2026, announced that Mr. Aseem Dhru ceases to be the CEO of the Company with effect from close of business hours of 31 March, 2026, on account of his resignation considered at the Company's Board Meeting and based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, the Board has approved his re-designation as a Non-Executive Non- Independent Director designated as Vice-Chairman of the Company, liable to retire by rotation, effective 1 April, 2026, subject to such approvals as may be required. Mr. Aseem Dhru is the Managing Director and CEO of the Company. He holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Gujarat University. news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 4 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 4 independent directors. 5 non-independent directors. Independent Director Koni Nayak was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
